title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A fairly gentle Sunday edition: Charlotte is chilly and sunny with a warm-up on the way, a local restaurant handed out Thanksgiving turkey checks, and doctors reported a first-of-its-kind bone marrow transplant. In politics, Mike Pence weighed in on where Republicans go after the midterms, and Jamaica's prime minister spoke on Cuba and on tensions in Parliament.

stories.headline: Holness: Jamaica stands with Cuba's people, charts its own foreign policy
stories.summary: Speaking at the Jamaica Labour Party's annual conference, Prime Minister Andrew Holness said Jamaica stands in solidarity with the Cuban people and will keep welcoming Cuban professionals under Jamaican and international law. He defended the government's recent abstention on a UN vote calling for an end to the US embargo on Cuba, which the opposition PNP has criticized. Holness said dialogue between the US and Cuba, plus reforms in Cuba, are the practical path forward.
key_facts: Remarks made at the JLP's 83rd annual conference in Montego Bay
Jamaica abstained on a UN vote on ending the US embargo of Cuba
The abstention came a day after Parliament approved a motion calling for the embargo to be lifted, a motion with bipartisan support for 30+ years
The opposition has also objected to curbs on the Cuban medical programme
stories.why: It signals how Jamaica plans to balance its relationships with Cuba and the West, including the doctors and nurses who work in its health system.

links.title: Jamaica stands in solidarity with Cuba but eschews outdated ideological rhetoric—Holness

stories.headline: Jamaica's PM defends Speaker, who is also his wife, amid tense Parliament
stories.summary: Andrew Holness strongly defended House Speaker Juliet Holness, his wife, after a standoff with opposition members earlier this month. He said the government won't allow 'bullyism and disorder' in Parliament, while describing his party as peace-loving and focused on order and rules. Relations between the Speaker and the opposition PNP have been strained.
key_facts: Spoken at the JLP conference in Montego Bay on Sunday
A near-fistfight in the House on November 3 involved the PNP's Mikael Phillips and the JLP's Desmond McKenzie
Juliet Holness serves as Speaker of the House of Representatives
stories.why: Heated relations in Parliament can affect how smoothly Jamaica's laws get debated and passed.

links.title: Holness defends wife, warns bullies will not be allowed to take over Parliament

stories.headline: Charlotte: frosty mornings, then a slow climb toward 70
stories.summary: Sunday was sunny but chilly, with highs struggling to reach the mid-50s. Patchy frost is likely Monday morning, but afternoons warm up through the week, reaching near 70 by Friday and the weekend. Lots of sunshine, though very little of the rain the area needs.
key_facts: Monday morning lows near or below freezing
Highs in the 60s midweek, near 70 Friday and the weekend
Nights stay in the 30s
Little chance of rain all week
stories.why: Grab a jacket for the Monday commute, and save the weekend for being outside.

links.title: Sunny but chilly Sunday in Charlotte before temperatures warm this week
Sunny but cool for the Charlotte area today

stories.headline: T-Boz's daughter Chase Rolison on lupus recovery and her vintage clothing dream
stories.summary: Chase Rolison, daughter of TLC's T-Boz and rapper Mack 10, told Reginae Carter that a lupus hospitalization last year lasted 20-some days, though she remembers it as about three, and that she had to relearn walking. She credited her mom's openness about living with sickle cell disease for helping her cope. She also talked about her vintage clothing business, Anela Vintage, and her hopes to design her own pieces.
key_facts: Interview aired on Reginae Carter's YouTube channel
Anela Vintage focuses on late-1990s and early-2000s styles, with an appointment-based showroom in West Hollywood
Her long-term goal is a store on Melrose
disputed: These are Chase's own personal accounts from an interview; no medical details beyond what she shared were reported
stories.why: It's a candid look at living with a chronic illness, and a nice reminder that life and ambitions keep going.

links.title: T-Boz’s Daughter Chase Rolison Recalls Memory Loss During Lupus Hospitalization

stories.headline: Charlotte spot hands out 500 turkey checks for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Marquee Charlotte, a west Charlotte restaurant and lounge, gave away 500 Butterball gift checks to area residents on Sunday. Each check is worth $25 and can be used for turkey and other groceries wherever Butterball products are sold.
key_facts: 500 gift checks, $25 each
Redeemable for turkey and other grocery items
Given out Sunday, ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.why: A small local business helping hundreds of families get dinner on the table.

links.title: Marquee Charlotte gives away 500 turkey gift checks ahead of Thanksgiving

stories.headline: First-of-its-kind marrow transplant from an organ donor treats aplastic anemia
stories.summary: Doctors at Franciscan Health say they performed the first reported transplant using bone marrow from a deceased organ donor to treat severe aplastic anemia, a non-cancerous disease. Six months later, the 40-year-old patient's blood counts are restored and she no longer needs transfusions. The marrow came from Ossium, which banks marrow recovered from organ donors.
key_facts: Transplant performed April 18 on a 40-year-old woman with a 10-year history of the disease
She has full donor chimerism, meaning her blood is now made entirely by donor cells, without complications
Ossium plans more transplants through its HOPE Program
disputed: This is a single patient case reported by the hospital and the marrow bank, not a clinical trial
Six months of follow-up is encouraging but still early for long-term results
stories.why: Banking marrow from organ donors could give more patients a match when they have no living donor.

links.title: World-First Bone Marrow Transplant Successfully Treats Non-Malignant Disease

stories.headline: Pence urges an open 2028 GOP race and disagrees with Vance on midterm loss
stories.summary: On NBC's Meet the Press, former Vice President Mike Pence called for a competitive 2028 Republican primary and declined to call Vice President JD Vance the frontrunner. He disagreed with Vance's view that the Iran conflict cost Republicans the midterms, arguing instead that voters were frustrated the operation stopped after five weeks. Vance hasn't said whether he'll run, citing his family.
key_facts: Republicans lost control of both the House and Senate in this year's midterms
Vance wrote on X that 'the reason we lost is the war'
Pence called Vance 'a good man' but said he is 'wrong'
Pence wants the party to return to its traditional conservative agenda
stories.why: It's an early look at the debate over the Republican Party's direction heading toward 2028.

stories.headline: Study finds brain activity varies widely among autistic people
stories.summary: University of Iowa researchers compared brain activity in people with and without autism and found remarkable variability among autistic individuals. The study was published in JNeurosci.
key_facts: Led by Dorit Kliemann and James Traer, University of Iowa
Published in JNeurosci
stories.why: It supports the idea that autism looks different from person to person.

links.title: People with autism show remarkable variability in brain activity
